prior_review.ego_observer: 50/54/55 flow-feature regressions, not HUD constrained registration
prior_review.background_motion: 56 free SVD rotation; no HUD fixed translation tested in reviewed records

target: Hull-origin pose displacement R(-currentangle)*(currentposition-previousposition), order right,forward metres. No COM offset, instantaneous velocity, future terminal frame or GT inference.
recipe: Unchanged background_motion.register; capture same accepted inlier p/q. Freeze shared original acceptance/abstention including free-fit scale,RMS,rotation gates. Fixed rotation R(delta) where delta=.08*(previousHUDyaw+currentHUDyaw)/2; translation=qmean-R*pmean. No new residual gate or search.
fallback: Same current legal296 HUD norm speed x .08 as forward displacement, zero lateral; apply identically at original registration abstentions. It is an assumption, not measured longitudinal motion.
anchor_source: Unchanged56 TRAIN-only fixed calibration; no refit
quantile_recipe: Inverse weighted empirical CDF, equal mass per road within each stratum; not interpolation or pooled length weighting.
limitations: Known six TRAIN trajectories, correlated intervals, not control benefit or new generalization validation.
Shared original free-fit acceptance freezes support; this does not evaluate a newly designed constrained-fit acceptance rule.
HUD trapezoidal endpoint integration is approximate, not true interval yaw; fallback norm speed assumes no lateral motion.
Hull-origin finite displacement differs from COM displacement and instantaneous velocity; no instant-state engineering claim.
decision: HUD-constrained translation is not a supported replacement on this fixed cache: lateral MAE/p95 worsen on all six roads; forward RMSE gain alone does not establish observer/controller benefit. No native or policy change.
